issues.problem: Under the model's own orientation (camera looking at L2 with the welcome galley forward, i.e. on the right), both LALF photos show the lining mirrored relative to the render. Photo: viewing window right of the handle housing (forward), arming-indicator window upper left (aft), arc arrowhead on the right pointing down. Render m18: window on the left (aft, wz = c+0.28 in 07_shell.js), arming window upper right (c-0.41), arrowhead on the left (aft). So either the lining is mirrored or the photos face R2, in which case the welcome galley sits aft of the cross-aisle facing forward and the 05_layout amendment is reversed. The two cannot both be right. The comment in 10_mono and REFERENCE777 cites 'TPG door 2L exterior' for window-aft, which contradicts LALF under the current layout.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/lalf_133.jpeg (window at x~790 of 1500, right of the arc; arming box at x~620, y~450, left; arrowhead at x~740, right), lalf_134.jpeg (same arrangement); w7/m18_doorL2.png (window x~350 left, arming panel x~470 right, arrowhead left).
issues.fix: Settle the question first (see questionsForUser). If LALF is L2: in buildMonuments' door-lining loop, negate every dz (LF(..., -0.41) -> +0.41, arc centre c-0.10 -> c+0.10 with t mirrored, arrowhead and stop bar swapped, strap dz -0.33 -> +0.33). 07_shell.js wz = c+0.28 -> c-0.28 also needs to change, which is the shell owner's file. If LALF is R2: keep the lining and swap the door-2 welcome galley and ash wall fore/aft in the 05_layout amendment (M('galley', -1.10, 1.10, 14.86, dz[1][0], {welcome}) vs the d2aft ashWall galley).

issues.detail: Welcome galley glass door still has no pane or frame
issues.problem: The cabinet now has a lit interior, but there is no glazing surface and no door frame. Real: a full-height framed door with a ~4 cm charcoal stile all round, a hinge strip on the right, a smoked pane with a soft sheen (#8c8b85 where it catches the light), and a large round latch set on the left stile at mid-height, overlapping the gap to the screen. Render: open shelves with a separate latch box floating to the left.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley, at the w5 glass-door block (~line 323): add a gRBox stile frame (0.04 m bars) round the opening in MONMAT.navyPanel/charcoal, plus a glass quad 5 mm in front of the shelves with a GLASS-like material (c '#3a3a38', r 0.08, alpha or sheen) so the shelves are dimmed about 40 %. Move the round latch onto the left stile at y ~ deck+0.55, and drop the separate latch box.

issues.problem: Still darker than the photo: #33312c in the render against #555150 / #514d41 (omaat_room_32). The panel reveals are invisible.
issues.fix: Lift the welcome upper-unit material (MONMAT.navyPanel '#3a3734' and the upper body material in buildWelcomeGalley) to about '#4a4742', and add 3 mm dark reveal grooves between the screen bay, oven bay and glass bay.

issues.problem: There are still two flat white rectangles plus a red block above the cabinet. Real: one cream rounded tag with a pictogram ('Return to Seat') and a black caution text plate under it. The brewer is a plain grey box. Real: a chrome espresso-type brewer with a drip tray and a green light.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley, replace the two cardWhite quads with one gRBox(0.24, 0.06, 0.01, 0.025) in cream '#e8e2d2' plus a 0.20 x 0.08 black plate below it, and remove the red block. Build the brewer from gCyl plus gRBox in MAT.handle (brushed) with a black spout box.

issues.detail: F front drape in mid-aisle; ebony grain
issues.problem: q01 and m02 still show one drape hanging in the middle of the aisle opening, so the view aft is half blocked. omaatF_40 shows the curtains bunched against the wall edges. The drape is also warm (#4a423f / #534a45) against the photo's neutral grey (#5c5753 / #393836). The fWood ebony on the door-1 walls (q01, m19) still reads as uniform horizontal streaks.
issues.fix: In buildMonuments' curtain placement, push the F-front drape to the opening edge (xg at the wall side, tied = true), and make MONMAT curtainF more neutral, e.g. '#625d5a'. Lower the fWood LAYER contrast and stretch its grain.

issues.detail: Bar upper-left blind is a featureless void
issues.problem: The pulled-down blind on the bar's left renders #030305-#050507 across about a third of the unit, so it reads as a hole. Even in the ANA render it is a visible slatted or fabric blind.
issues.fix: In buildBar, give the blind a mid-dark material (c '#2a2826', LAYER.fabric) with horizontal 2 mm reveals every 0.05 m, plus a bottom rail in MONMAT.bronze.

issues.detail: 2R deck stub reads as a cushion
issues.problem: Next to the 2R jump seat (m13), the black deck piece left by the split sits on the ash base like a floor cushion. It has no nosing and no wall behind it reaching up to the inserts.
issues.fix: In buildGalley, when jumpX is set, either finish the remaining deck segment with the aluminium nosing and end cap, or drop it to a flush ash top at the base height.

issues.detail: Door handle colour and m04 seam
issues.problem: The lining handle is a dark grey block. lalf_133 shows a brushed silver lever (#b89b89 lit, #6c6261 shade). The faint vertical seam in the lower middle ash flap of m04 is still there.
issues.fix: Door loop: the grip pocket '#4a4641' -> '#8a8680', grip in MAT.handle with lower roughness. buildAshWall: merge the lower middle flap into one gRBox.

questionsForUser: Door 2: lalf_133/134 show the viewing window forward of the handle and the arming box aft, if the camera faces L2 as the model assumes. The model has it the other way round (window aft, per a TPG 2L exterior). Is the welcome monitor galley forward of the door-2 cross-aisle (photo = L2, lining mirrored) or aft of it (photo = R2, galley placement reversed)? An exterior photo of JA7xxA door 2L, or a photo taken while boarding through 2L, would settle it.
